name: Guelph / Aberfoyle / Bramalea
description: A former express Guelph–Bramalea train connection via Aberfoyle, distinct from Kitchener route 30 and local Georgetown route 33.

timeline.event: The original booklet identifies 39 with one weekday eastbound trip and three westbound train meets.
39 was discontinued in the Kitchener corridor reorganization.
